items.title: Derek Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: I’m the pianist for Mr. Pavarotti... Well I played the hell out of it. And I listed that on my resume — played with Pavarotti.

ctx.x: Some of the most fun people you backed up.

Well, lots of people. It wasn’t on that particular show, I’m trying to think of that particular show, but really the funniest story was it wasn’t the Tonight Show, but it was at the same time. I came home from work and I think it was after Benny and there was a message from our service, we all belonged to this service it was called. And my wife had said that the Registry called, you’ve got to be at ABC Television at 5:30 it’s the Good Morning America show, you know, it’s a network show, you’ve got to accompany…
